findings.title_text: Interest to Invented One Lender: whether it crosses the s.194A threshold is not computed -- a voucher that both credits and debits the loan carries interest
limits_text: 1 voucher(s) both credit and debit this loan and carry its interest ledger or a TDS ledger; this test lists each as the books hold it and does not divide it into entries. Their interest (₹0) is shown beside the interest total, not in it; any TDS on them is in the TDS seen on the loan, unless the voucher also posts to another configured loan. The interest crosses the s.194A threshold (₹10,000) in some readings of the interest lines on those vouchers and not in others (from ₹2,000 to ₹22,000), so whether it crosses is not computed. This loan is in no clause 21(b) item from this test.
s.40(a)(ia) disallows 30% of the interest on a TDS default; the second proviso removes this if the lender's Form 26A (Rule 31ACB) shows the interest was returned as income.
ask_client_text: The interest credited to Invented One Lender for the year, the TDS deducted on it under s.194A, and the challans showing it was deposited.

findings.title_text: Loan ledger both credited and debited in one voucher: listed as the books hold it, not divided into entries by this test (Invented One Lender) (possible s.269SS/269T)
limits_text: This voucher credits the loan ₹500 and debits it ₹500. This test does not yet divide a voucher with both sides on one loan into its entries, so it lists it as the books hold it: in no reportable total and not in the s.269SS/269T flag count. Both sides stay in the loan's credits and debits before any filter.
Every entry on this loan dated on or after this voucher is tested on its own amount only: its reportability by the running balance is not computed, and neither is the loan's maximum balance.

Possible s.269SS and s.269T: the voucher's other debit and credit lines each include a ledger that is not a bank account (cash, a journal or another ledger). Whether a limit is breached is not computed; this is not in the s.269SS/269T flag count.
It was not compared with this loan's other entries for reversal pairs or repeated narrations.
ask_client_text: Entry by entry, what was taken from the lender, repaid to it, credited as interest or a charge, and withheld as TDS in this voucher, and by what mode (cash, bank, adjustment)? If part of it corrects another part, which?
